widgets_values: Roformer Model: MelBand Roformer | Vocals by Kimberley Jensen
Roformer Model: MelBand Roformer | De-Reverb by anvuew

Nine ensemble recipes, one audio input.

Set your track in Load Audio (audio/Ensemble9 is where the stems land).

Not in the audio-separator model library, so not wired:
  Kim_Inst_1            -> the library's Kim Inst is used in the Guitar recipe instead
  UVR-BVE-4B_WhiteNoise -> the library has no noise-floor model at all; the Other recipe
                           keeps the two kuielab models and the htdemucs_6s other stem.

One source instead of an ensemble, because the library has nothing else:
  Strings, Brass   both reduce to 17_HP-Wind_Inst-UVR (woodwinds). There is no string or
                   brass model in the library, and htdemucs_6s has no such stem.

Recipe notes not wired here:
  VoxBacking   subtracting the VoxMain output needs a second blend stage
  Brass        subtracting Strings from the wind output is the same subtraction

Reading the graph: the raw track goes to every two-stem model and to BS-Roformer; that
model's instrumental feeds MDX23C-InstVoc HQ, whose instrumental feeds htdemucs_6s - so the
six-stem split works on a vocal-free bed.
